decision.summary: The Federal Reserve decided to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent.

changes.quote: The unemployment rate remains low, and labor market conditions remain solid.
changes.explanation: The Committee updated its assessment of the labor market to state that unemployment remains low and conditions are solid.

changes.quote: Uncertainty about the economic outlook has diminished but remains elevated.
changes.explanation: This change shows that the Committee believes overall uncertainty has decreased, though it is still at an elevated level.

changes.quote: The Committee is attentive to the risks to both sides of its dual mandate.
changes.explanation: The Fed removed specific language about risks of higher unemployment and higher inflation having risen, returning to a balanced view.

tone_quotes.quote: Although swings in net exports have affected the data, recent indicators suggest that economic activity has continued to expand at a solid pace.
The Committee is strongly committed to supporting maximum employment and returning inflation to its 2 percent objective.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 21.37% APR costs about $89.04 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 4.38% and moved -1 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 6.85% would fall by about $2.00 a month.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 4.3%, and employers added an average of 63k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 2.4% over the past year (May 2025); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 2.8%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 0.1% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved 0 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved -0.03%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved 0.19% on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that the Committee will carefully assess incoming data and the evolving outlook at upcoming meetings. As an educational note, the forecast model gives the next meeting a 63% chance of a hold and a 37% chance of a cut.

citations.detail: In support of its goals, the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent.
